label: Position-locked: <DEL> step of L=3 sequences and first copy-input step (recall_idx 1) of L=9 sequences
explanation: Very sparse, weak unit (max 0.049, about 0.03% of steps). Every activation falls in one of two position slots: (a) the delimiter step t=3 of L=3 sequences (24% of mass), strongest when the last original token is n (e.g. d n n <DEL>); (b) t=L+1, the first copy step after <DEL>, almost entirely for L=9 (74% of mass), plus a few for L=8. Here the input is the echoed first token, and it is strongest when that token is 3, m or d. It never fires during the original phase or at any later copy step. Even inside these slots it fires on only about 0.5% of steps, so position alone has recall 1.0 but precision about 0.01. Adding the token conditions raises dev precision to 0.14 at recall 0.61 (mass recall 0.74). The token preferences are graded tendencies, not clean rules.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=3 (+4.22), t=3 & prev_tok=n (+4.10), t=10 & in_tok=m (+3.02), L=3 & t=3 (+2.99), L=3 & recall_idx=0 (+2.99), t=3 & in_tok=<DEL> (+2.99).
